summary: Russian forces conducted a large-scale combined drone and missile attack across multiple Ukrainian regions including Kyiv, Sumy, and Zaporizhzhia, causing civilian casualties and infrastructure damage. Ukrainian air defenses tracked and intercepted multiple Shahed drones targeting cities such as Kryvyi Rih and Velyka Dymer. Fighting continued along several front lines including Kharkiv, Sumy, and Kherson directions.
key_points: Russian forces launched over 1,000 drones and missiles at 51 settlements in Zaporizhzhia region, injuring four civilians (Source: @UkraineNow/83579).
A nighttime Russian attack on Sumy left six injured, including a 16-year-old girl (Source: @UkraineNow/83579).
Two women were killed and two others injured in a Russian strike on Lebiazhe in Kharkiv region (Source: @UkraineNow/83579).
Russian drones targeted Kyiv overnight, killing 15 people and igniting a business center fire in Holosiivskyi district (Source: @UkraineNow/83578).
Ukrainian air defenses intercepted multiple Shahed drones over Velyka Dymer, Desna, and other Kyiv suburbs (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70847).
Russian reconnaissance and strike drones attacked Dnipro, Zaporizhzhia, and Sumy regions from eastern and southern axes (Source: @eRadarrua/106516).
Fighting persists near Volnaya Sloboda, Ulanovo, and Pisarevka on the Sumy front (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32626).

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces carried out a major overnight combined attack using over 1,000 drones and missiles across 51 settlements in Zaporizhzhia region, causing civilian casualties and infrastructure damage. Ukrainian air defenses tracked and intercepted multiple Shahad drones targeting cities including Kyiv, Kryvyi Rih, and Sumy. Combat operations continued along key front lines in Kharkiv, Sumy, and Kherson directions.
ukraine: Kyiv came under a large-scale Russian drone and missile barrage overnight, resulting in at least 15 fatalities and a fire at a business center in Holosiivskyi district (Source: @UkraineNow/83578).
Air raid alerts were issued across Kyiv suburbs including Velyka Dymer, Desna, and Hostomel as Ukrainian air defenses engaged incoming Shahad drones (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70847).
In Kryvyi Rih, Russian forces destroyed the city’s largest shopping complex using low-flying Shahad drones launched from the Hvardiyske airfield in occupied Crimea (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70858).
The attack on Kryvyi Rih lasted over 18 hours, involving continuous rocket and drone bombardment, according to local monitoring sources (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70850).
Ukrainian officials confirmed that Russian strikes hit residential areas and critical infrastructure in multiple cities including Sumy and Zaporizhzhia (Source: @UkraineNow/83579).
russia: Russian Aerospace Forces conducted missile tests near the disputed Southern Chishima Islands claimed by Japan, prompting diplomatic protests from Tokyo (Source: @UkraineNow/83582).
Over 35 Russian unmanned aerial vehicles were destroyed overnight in Rostov region airspace during Ukrainian cross-border drone activity (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32626).
Russian border regions including Belgorod, Kursk, and Sumy reported ongoing cross-border shelling and drone incursions attributed to Ukrainian forces (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32626).

Fuel shortages emerged across Moscow and central Russia due to supply chain disruptions, with long queues forming at gas stations and reports of empty AI-95 and diesel pumps (Source: @eRadarrua/106495).
Russian state media reported continued military operations targeting Ukrainian energy infrastructure and logistics hubs in support of broader strategic objectives (Source: @tass_agency/391387).
eastern_front: On the Sumy front, the North border guard detachment engaged in combat near Volnaya Sloboda and Ulanovo, with additional clashes reported in Pisarevka and Maryino (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32626).
Russian forces launched reconnaissance drones near Pidhaichyky and strike drones toward Pavlohrad in Dnipropetrovsk region (Source: @eRadarrua/106491).
Ukrainian forces repelled an enemy counterattack near Ternovaya village on the Kharkiv front, with ongoing infantry engagements in Vasilievka and Dolzhanka (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32626).
Near Redkodub, north of Krasnyi Luch, Russian forces are reportedly building up troops, prompting redeployment of Ukrainian reserves (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32626).
On the Konstantinivka direction, Ukrainian forces claimed liberation of Nikolayevka village west of Konstantinivka (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32626).
northern_front: Russian drones struck targets in Chernihiv region, with one UAV heading toward Slavutych from the north (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70833).
A reconnaissance drone was detected near P'yatykhatky in Dnipropetrovsk region, indicating increased Russian surveillance activity (Source: @eRadarrua/106484).
Ukrainian air defenses tracked a Shahad drone approaching the Desna River area en route to Vyshgorod and Pogreby (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70833).
Cross-border drone activity increased along the Russia-Ukraine border in Sumy and Bryansk regions, with reports of small UAV groups (Source: @kpszsu/73767).
No major ground offensive developments were reported on the northern front during the period (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32626).
southern_front: Russian forces launched multiple reactive drones from the Black Sea toward Ochakiv and Mykolaiv, with one group heading toward Snihurivka (Source: @kpszsu/73753).
A group of Ukrainian drones was detected moving from Kherson region toward Mykolaiv, targeting Ochakiv (Source: @kpszsu/73766).
Russian strike drones attacked targets in Mykolaiv region from the east, heading toward Kazanka and Novyi Buh (Source: @kpszsu/73764).
Ukrainian air defenses intercepted two drones over Zaporizhzhia city during the night (Source: @eRadarrua/106484).
On the Kherson front, Ukrainian forces conducted air strikes against critical infrastructure in Kherson city (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32626).
air_war: Ukrainian air defenses tracked and intercepted multiple Shahad drones over Kyiv suburbs including Velyka Dymer, Hostomel, and Rusanivka (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70839).
Russian forces deployed reconnaissance and strike drones across Dnipro, Zaporizhzhia, and Sumy regions, with some targeting civilian infrastructure (Source: @eRadarrua/106516).
Air raid alerts were activated in Kyiv, Sumy, and Zaporizhzhia as Russian drone swarms approached from multiple directions (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70843).
Over 35 Russian UAVs were destroyed in Rostov region airspace overnight, indicating active Ukrainian electronic warfare deployment (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32626).
Russian missile tests near the Southern Chishima Islands triggered Japanese diplomatic protests and heightened regional tensions (Source: @UkraineNow/83582).

Kyiv suffered a major overnight attack with 15 fatalities and a business center fire in Holosiivskyi district (Source: @UkraineNow/83578).
Ukrainian air defenses intercepted multiple Shahad drones over Kyiv suburbs including Velyka Dymer, Desna, and Hostomel (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70847).

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces have escalated their campaign with coordinated drone and missile strikes targeting both military and civilian infrastructure across Ukraine. The use of low-flying Shahad drones launched from Crimea indicates an evolving tactical approach aimed at evading air defenses. Civilian casualties are rising, particularly in Kyiv and Zaporizhzhia regions, suggesting a deliberate strategy to undermine public morale. Cross-border drone activity in Sumy and Bryansk regions signals potential for further escalation along the northern axis. The destruction of critical infrastructure, including shopping centers and energy facilities, poses long-term risks to Ukraine’s economic stability and winter preparedness.
sections.regional_response: Ukrainian air defenses remain active across Kyiv, Sumy, and Zaporizhzhia regions, successfully intercepting multiple incoming threats. Local authorities have confirmed casualties and infrastructure damage, issuing emergency alerts and coordinating rescue efforts. Border security measures have been heightened following repeated cross-border drone incursions in Sumy and Bryansk regions. International partners continue monitoring the situation, with reports of ongoing discussions regarding additional military aid packages. Humanitarian response teams are mobilizing in affected areas to assist displaced residents and restore essential services.
sections.intelligence_notes: Recent Russian tactics emphasize low-altitude drone swarms launched from Crimea and Black Sea platforms, complicating Ukrainian air defense interception efforts. Electronic warfare capabilities appear to be playing a growing role in both reconnaissance and strike operations across the eastern and southern fronts. Fuel supply disruptions in central Russia may indicate logistical strain affecting Russian military readiness. Diplomatic fallout from Russian missile tests near Japanese territorial waters could influence broader regional security dynamics. Continued monitoring of cross-border drone activity is essential for assessing potential shifts in offensive posture along the northern front.
